name: Rosewood Mandarina
positioning: All-suite Riviera Nayarit resort set between the Pacific, the flatlands and the Sierra Madre mountains, with polo, golf and cliffside dining
best_for: Families and small groups wanting a villa with indoor and outdoor space
Riders and golfers, with a polo and equestrian club and a Greg Norman par-3 course
Food and agave lovers, with cooking classes and tequila and mezcal tastings

facts.text: Rosewood Mandarina is in Riviera Nayarit, Mexico.
Accommodation is all suites, with views over the natural terrain of Riviera Nayarit.
The suites have views of the ocean, the flatlands and the mountains.
The premium villas are the most spacious accommodation in the resort, with indoor and outdoor space suited to families and small groups.
Buena Onda is a casual beach shack at the base of the mountain, by the Pacific, serving Spanish coastal food: grilled seafood, tapas and paellas.
Toppu combines Japanese technique with Mexican flavors.
The resort offers an Agave Experience on tequila, mezcal, sotol and other agave spirits with its Head Tequilero.
Guests can take a Mexican cooking class on ancestral techniques with the culinary team.
Private dinners can be set on the beach by torchlight.
Menus use ingredients from a network of local producers.
Summer activities include sea turtle releases and ocean adventures.
Each specialty suite has living and dining space and a private plunge pool.

highlights.text: The Polo & Equestrian Club sits on the flatlands beneath the Sierra Madre peaks, where guests of all ages can ride, learn or watch seasonal polo matches.
Mandarina Golf Club is a 9-hole par-3 course designed by Greg Norman, with mountain views.
Barra Peñasco is an open-air bar perched on a cliff among ancient fig trees, with cocktails, Mexican spirits and live music at sunset.
Guests can take a panga to the Islas Marietas, a protected National Reserve of uninhabited islands, to spot rare birds and see Playa del Amor beneath a crater.
La Cocina Mandarina is the all-day restaurant, built around a traditional comal that makes handmade tortillas.

considerations.text: Sea turtle releases are offered as part of the summer season.
WhataHotel notes ultra-premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
